Built executables are [test4](/output/test4) and [target/release/test4](/output/target/release/test4). Verification passed with `cargo test --release`, `cargo build --release`, `rustc --edition 2021 test4.rs -O -o test4`, and byte-for-byte comparisons against `/workspace/dataset/test4_executable` for `n = -3..50` plus malformed inputs such as `abc`, `1x`, `+3`, `0004`, and `2147483648`.
